input.quote: No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies. Customer pays only for Services ordered in a mutually executed Order Form, and its decision not to enter another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall.
input.rationale: The Agreement sits at our preferred position. § 2.1 (p0012) expressly disclaims any minimum quantity or purchase commitment, confirms Customer pays only for Services ordered in an executed Order Form, and provides that declining to place further orders is neither a breach nor a shortfall. § 7.1 (p0026) reinforces this by barring any minimum-use or similar charge not identified in the Order Form, and § 12.3 (p0050) records that Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment. No take-or-pay, shortfall penalty, or volume cap on Customer usage appears anywhere in the document, so no fallback true-up or reduction mechanic is needed. The sole-and-exclusive supply undertaking in § 2.2 (p0013) is a sourcing restriction rather than a purchase or volume commitment and is addressed under the EXCLUSIVITY rule; we do not flag it twice here.
